newsitem.title: USA: New York bomb suspects in critical condition.
newsitem.headline: New York bomb suspects in critical condition.

text.p: Two men suspected of building powerful pipe-bombs with plans for a suicide bombing in New York were in critical but stable condition on Thursday, a week after they were shot during a police raid.

Police stormed their Brooklyn apartment before dawn on July 31, and opened fire when one of the men lunged toward one of five pipe bombs in the apartment in an attempt to activate it, authorities said.

Gazi Ibrahim Abu Mezer, 23, and Lafi Khalil, 22, both Palestinians, are being held under guard at Kings County Hospital in New York City, where they were in critical but stable condition, a spokeswoman said.
Mezer has been removed from a respirator but Khalil continues to use a respirator to help him breathe, she said, adding there were no signs of infection in either man.
Investigators believe the suspects were only hours away from bombing the Atlantic Avenue subway station in Brooklyn, which also serves the Long Island Rail Road, a major suburban commuter line.
Abu Mezer and Khalil have been charged with conspiracy. A third man is being held on an immigration charge, but authorities have not divulged his name.
Investigators are trying to determine whether the suspects were associated with any militant groups.
